svg.text: Base Excision Repair (BER) vs. Nucleotide Excision Repair (NER)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: BER flips out single damaged bases one at a time; NER recognises bulky helix distortions and excises a ~25–30 nt patch

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: BER — small non-distorting base lesions (U, 8-oxoG)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. DNA Glycosylase (e.g. UNG)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flips damaged base out & clips glycosidic bond → AP site

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. AP Endonuclease (APE1)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nicks sugar-phosphate backbone at the abasic site

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. DNA Pol β (short-patch)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Removes sugar remnant & inserts 1 correct nucleotide

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. DNA Ligase III / XRCC1

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seals final nick → intact original sequence restored

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NER — bulky helix-distorting lesions (UV thymine dimers)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Distortion sensor (XPC / stalled Pol II)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Detects helix kink, NOT exact chemical identity of lesion

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. TFIIH helicase (XPB / XPD)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unwinds ~25–30 bp open bubble around bulky adduct

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Dual endonucleases (XPF + XPG)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make TWO cuts flanking lesion → excise ~27 nt oligo

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. DNA Pol δ/ε + Ligase I

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Refills 27 nt gap using intact strand; XP defect → UV cancer
